# repo.patch

Apply multiple patches to multiple files atomically

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `backup` | boolean | No | - |
| `base_dir` | string | No | - |
| `dry_run` | boolean | No | - |
| `output_file` | string | No | - |
| `patchset` | string | No | - |
| `patchset_file` | string | No | - |
| `strict` | boolean | No | - |

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd
